showcase.action_alert_body: send a message notifying the user of their infraction.
showcase.action_delete_body: delete the message that triggered the infraction, keeping your channels clean.
showcase.action_log_body: send a message to the moderation log channel for moderators to see.
showcase.automod_attachments_alert: file attachments aren't allowed in this channel.
showcase.automod_capitals_alert: please reduce your use of capital letters.
showcase.automod_intro: Choose which messages trigger a rule, then decide how WolfStar responds.
showcase.automod_invites_alert: invite links aren't allowed in this channel.
showcase.automod_links_alert: you sent links that aren't allowed here.
showcase.automod_newlines_alert: your message contains too many lines.
showcase.automod_reactions_alert: you cannot react with that emoji.
showcase.automod_spam_alert: please refrain from reposting the same message multiple times.
showcase.automod_words_alert: you said something that is not allowed in this server.
showcase.escalation_action_body: warn, timeout, kick, or ban, with a temporary or permanent duration where supported.
showcase.escalation_intro: Repeated infractions can trigger a separate escalation rule:
showcase.escalation_threshold_body: choose how many infractions within a time window trigger the action.
showcase.feature_automod_description: Move through real filter examples and see the message, response, and escalation controls together.
showcase.feature_automod_title: Configure the rule before it fires
showcase.feature_logging_description: Choose which server events reach Discord, then search moderation, command, and settings history in the dashboard.
showcase.feature_logging_title: Keep live events and reviewable history
showcase.feature_moderation_description: Every moderation action keeps the details your team needs to review it.
showcase.header_description: Use the controls to inspect the same moderation flow your team configures and reviews.
showcase.header_title: Follow a rule from trigger to review.
showcase.logging_intro: Send member, channel, role, message, and moderation events to the Discord channels your team already watches.
showcase.logging_item_filter: Filter moderation history by member, moderator, action, date, or search text.
showcase.logging_item_views: Keep command outcomes and dashboard settings activity in their own reviewable views.
showcase.mod_copy_audit: WolfStar can also record supported moderation actions performed directly in Discord, including their audit-log reason.
showcase.mod_copy_search: Search moderation history by member, moderator, action, date, or text. Each entry keeps the action and reason together.
